description: Who texts from a US SMS short code (the 4- to 6-digit numbers businesses text from), from areacode.fyi's directory of codes verified against each owner's own documentation. Returns the owner, what the texts are, how to opt out, how often the brand is impersonated, and the owner's source page. An unlisted code is unverified, not proof of a scam.
name: lookup_short_code
title: Look up an SMS short code
